name: mago homolog, exon junction complex subunit

function.text: MAGOH is the approved symbol for mago homolog, exon junction complex subunit. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in mRNA export from nucleus; mRNA metabolic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: nbl. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
